shared_elements: single standing/frontal anthropomorphic figure filling a tall vertical field
headdress or cap on the head
horizontal banding across the body (belt/skirt-like divisions)
patterned surface texture on the body
justification: Both are tall vertical stone panels dominated by one frontal anthropomorphic figure whose head sits at the top, arms folded across a banded torso, with rounded disc motifs and skirt-like horizontal divisions below. The rendering, however, is entirely different: A is a coarse, heavily eroded, near-schematic low relief on an irregular boulder with barely legible incisions, while B is a crisp, densely detailed carving with scale patterning, fringed garment, modelled musculature and a clearly held handled vessel that has no counterpart in A.
